title: AXM delta observation
description: What a higher rung did that a lower rung missed, observed on one task — the raw material of frontier capture. Rows live in data/capture/*.jsonl with record_type 'delta_observation', usually alongside the capture entry they justify. A delta is an observation, never a claim of general superiority; it is scoped to its task_id.

delta_types.description: edge_delta = a rule-boundary commitment; framing_delta = task presentation changed the outcome; routing_delta = the model choice itself; spec_delta = spec reading divergence; transport_delta = serialization damage, not capability (adjudicate, never count as model failure).

capturable.description: Can this delta be frozen into a reusable artifact?

captured_as.description: Required non-empty when capturable is true: the artifact class (edge_family, hidden_grader, scaffold_packet, routing_rule, lens).

measured.description: true = backed by graded trials in a sealed known_corner.jsonl layer (evidence_layer required and must resolve); false = hypothesis. Measured and hypothesis are different words — a delta must say which it is.

evidence_layer.description: The known_corner.jsonl layer carrying the graded trials. Required (and resolved by the validator) when measured is true.

evidence.description: Ledger rows / evidence layers behind the observation.
